why: All five figures use the same five signs: x, =, O, + and triangle. In options 1, 2 and 3 the pairs are the same: x sits beside =, O sits beside +, and the triangle stands alone (option 2 is option 1 turned upside down). Option 4 breaks this most clearly: x sits next to + and the triangle is paired with =, so we choose option 4.
trick: Check which signs stay together as pairs; turning a figure does not break pairs.
